proposal: Two tanks of 3,500 m3 net working volume each (about 4,000 m3 gross); no requirement to sustain operation beyond 72 h.
question: 72 h at base load on LDO is about 6,900 m3 (two tanks of about 3,500 m3 net). The supplier's maximum of 25 trucks/day (about 825 m3/day) covers only about 36 % of base-load consumption. Please confirm that the plant is not required to run beyond the storage autonomy, and that 'net working volume' excludes heel and fire-fighting reserves.
response: Confirmed: two tanks of 3,500 m3 net working volume each (heel and fire-fighting reserves in addition); the plant is not required to operate beyond the storage autonomy.
subject: LDO storage volume and resupply rate
